datasets: COMMON CRAWL NEWS ARTICLES FROM JANUARY 2020
outputs: Paragraph continuations (80-145 tokens) generated from one-sentence news prompts

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant task descriptions, normalized model names to standard forms, removed 'Human' from models list as it's not an NLG model, and simplified dataset description
Removed 'Error prediction model' as it's not a standard automatic metric for evaluating NLG outputs (it's a model trained on the SCARECROW data), kept standard NLG evaluation metrics
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper

guideline: Annotators mark spans of text with one of ten error types, assign a severity level (1-3), and provide a natural language explanation

changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant/generic criteria descriptions, kept the specific 10 error types used in the SCARECROW framework

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating NLG systems using the SCARECROW framework for human evaluation of machine-generated text. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and consolidation of redundant items. The paper primarily contributes a human evaluation methodology rather than proposing new automatic metrics.
